_about: Per-fish skin lines (owner, 2026-10-10: "skins to be different for each playable fish. Common skins should be similar to original just with realistic fish reshades and the rarer they get the wilder they get"; 12 per fish). Every line skin belongs to one fish only. Commons are realistic colour morphs of the real species, keeping the fish's own painted look; each tier up is wilder. The universal skins (catch track, weekly, trophies) are made for every fish. Ids are global and unique; the in-game config is src/shared/Config/Shades.luau. `new` marks a recipe to write; the others already exist in make_shades.py.

line.name: Percula
line.look: Close to its own look: vivid orange body, three crisp white bands each edged in a thin black line, orange fins with black-edged tips.

line.name: Tomato
line.look: Tomato clownfish: saturated red-orange body darkening to deep red-black on the rear flanks, ONE white band behind the eye only, red fins.

line.name: Maroon
line.look: Maroon clownfish: deep wine-maroon body, three thin golden-yellow bands, dark maroon fins.

line.name: Midnight
line.look: Black ocellaris morph: glossy black body, three bright white bands, a saturated orange face and snout.

line.name: Great
line.look: Great barracuda: steel-silver body, blue-grey back, about 18-22 slanted dark bars on the upper flank, a scatter of inky black blotches on the lower rear flank, dark forked tail.

line.name: Yellowtail
line.look: Yellowtail barracuda: blue-silver back, bright silver flank, one saturated yellow lateral stripe nose to tail, yellow tail fin.

line.name: Chevron
line.look: Chevron barracuda: gunmetal body with dark V-shaped chevrons pointing forward along the flank, silver belly, grey fins.

line.name: Blackfin
line.look: Blackfin barracuda: polished bright steel body (slight sheen), every fin and the tail tipped jet black, a faint dark lateral line.

line.name: Chrome
line.look: Mirror chrome (metal map) with long horizontal speed streaks raking back from the nose, a cool blue reflection on the back, black fin edges. Reads fast.

line.name: Comet
line.look: Deep space-blue body; the head is a blazing cyan-white comet core and a glowing tail of sparks and streaks pours back along the flanks to the tail. Glow map on the core and sparks (tint any near-white glow toward cyan/blue).

line.name: Guineafowl
line.look: Guineafowl puffer: charcoal-black body densely covered in small round white spots, spots smaller on the face, dark fins.

line.name: Golden
line.look: Golden morph of the guineafowl puffer: saturated lemon-yellow all over, a few small dark speckles on the back, yellow fins. Saturated yellow only, never cream or beige.

line.name: Starry
line.look: Starry puffer: blue-grey back with large round black spots, cool white belly (silver-blue white), grey fins.

line.name: Green Spotted
line.look: Green spotted puffer: olive-lime green back with round dark spots, yellow-green belly fading to a cool white, translucent green fins.

line.name: Urchin
line.look: Sea urchin: deep purple-black body with thin radiating teal-blue spine lines bursting outward from the middle of each flank, the spines' tips brighter turquoise.

line.name: Coral Bloom
line.look: Living coral grows over it: clusters of polyp cells and branching coral in saturated orange, violet and yellow patches over a teal base, each polyp a little star.

line.name: Sunburst
line.look: A sun: radiant golden rays burst from the body's middle over deep saturated orange, the rays metallic gold (metal map), a glowing gold core (glow map). Golds without blue; hard edges, no soft orange-to-white blends.

line.name: Green
line.look: Green moray: rich olive-green body with subtle darker mottling, a slightly yellower throat, green fin edge.

line.name: Zebra
line.look: Zebra moray: near-black blue-brown body ringed by about 30 thin cool-white rings all along its length.

line.name: Snowflake
line.look: Snowflake moray: mid-toned cool grey base (never cream), covered in black star-shaped dendritic blotches with small bright yellow centres.

line.name: Honeycomb
line.look: Honeycomb moray: saturated golden-yellow base under a dark near-black honeycomb net, the cells large on the flanks and small on the head.

line.name: Serpent
line.look: Sea serpent: emerald dragon scales, each scale edged in gold (metal on the edges), a darker green back.

line.name: Ribbon
line.look: Ribbon eel: electric cobalt-blue body with a vivid yellow dorsal fin edge and yellow snout and jaw.

line.name: Jade Dragon
line.look: Carved polished jade (deep to pale green, cool) with gold filigree whorls along the flanks (metal), the filigree faintly glowing.

line.name: Blacktip
line.look: Blacktip reef shark: blue-grey back, cool white belly, every fin and the tail tipped solid black.

line.name: Whitetip
line.look: Whitetip reef shark: dark slate-grey body with a few small dark spots, the first dorsal fin and tail tips bright cool white.

line.name: Grey Reef
line.look: Grey reef shark: even mid-grey back, white belly, a broad black trailing edge on the tail fin.

line.name: Lemon
line.look: Lemon shark: saturated mustard-olive yellow body (never tan or beige), paler cool yellow belly, yellow fins.

line.name: Warpaint
line.look: Tribal warpaint: dark charcoal hide with bold teal and black slashes across the face, gills and flanks, like painted war stripes.

line.name: Battle-Scarred
line.look: A veteran: grey hide crossed by many healed scars and crescent bite marks (paler cool grey ridges with dark edges), a torn fin edge, tooth gouges.

line.name: Bone Plate
line.look: Armoured like a placoderm: gunmetal hide under overlapping cool bone-grey armour plates over the head and back, dark seams between plates.

line.name: Seadevil
line.look: Black seadevil: matte velvet black body with a faint cool blue sheen on the ridges. The lure keeps its glow.

line.name: Humpback
line.look: Humpback anglerfish: dark olive-grey (cool, never brown) with a darker back and slightly lighter flanks.

line.name: Warty
line.look: Warty angler: mottled charcoal and slate-blue skin covered in small raised cool-grey bumps.

line.name: Footballfish
line.look: Footballfish: dark cobalt-black body studded with a grid of tiny bony points, a deep blue belly.

line.name: Murk
line.look: Silt-grey matte skin with drifting dark sediment streaks and floating particle specks, like it lives in the mud.

line.name: Driftwood
line.look: Grey bleached driftwood grain (cool grey, never tan) with barnacle clusters (white-blue rings) on the back.

line.name: Bioglow
line.look: Near-black body sprinkled with tiny faint blue glowing freckles (glow map), denser along the belly.

line.name: Glassveins
line.look: Deep indigo body with a branching network of glowing cyan veins (glow map) like it's lit from inside.

line.name: Abyss Eye
line.look: Horror (no gore): black body covered in dozens of glowing amber eyes of different sizes, each an iris ring with a dark slit pupil (glow map on the irises).

line.name: Lantern King
line.look: Ornate gold lantern filigree (metal) over deep navy, a crown of glowing gold spines along the back (glow), gold-trimmed fins. Golds without blue.

line.name: Starfall
line.look: Black body full of glowing constellations: stars joined by thin glowing lines, a few falling stars streaking down the flanks (glow map; tint whites toward blue-violet).

universal.name: Golden
universal.look: Polished solid gold (metal map), the fish's own pattern showing through as darker gold engraving. Golds without blue, hard edges.

universal.name: Glowing
universal.look: Bioluminescent: deep navy body, the fish's own pattern lines and markings glowing cyan-green (glow map).

universal.name: Crystal
universal.look: Clear crystal: icy blue facets with bright glints and cool inner refractions (mid-toned, cool; gloss finish).

universal.name: Prism
universal.look: Holographic prism foil: a rainbow that sweeps across the body with the surface's facing, the fish's own pattern embossed through it, a faint glow.

universal.name: Great Wave
universal.look: A woodblock-print great wave: deep ultramarine body with curling cool-white foam crests and claw-like spray rolling along the flanks.

universal.name: Living Reef
universal.look: A whole reef painted on: brain coral, sea fans and tiny fish silhouettes in saturated reef colours over turquoise.

universal.name: Shipwreck
universal.look: Riveted iron hull plates, orange-red rust streaks (saturated), barnacle clusters and a painted hull number on the flank.

universal.name: Sea Glass
universal.look: A mosaic of frosted sea-glass pebbles in bottle green, cobalt and amber, with soft dark grout between them.
